obligations.feature: Unread marker, mark-as-unread action and jump-to-next-unread command
obligations.gap: #443 on 1f43a15: unread now sets itself. A chat whose turn settles (completed, nothing queued; Conductor's applyTurnCompletionTails, index-BGEQ8YjU.js @1,529,959), a new Reason permission request, or a new Codex approval marks its workspace unread unless that chat's transcript is shown with the window focused (Conductor's isSessionInView/QW; features/chat/attention.ts, state/autoUnread.ts, useAutoUnread.ts in App.tsx). Showing an unread workspace's chat with the window focused reads it, except after a hand mark (R or row menu) until it is opened again (manuallyUnreadSessions). The composer shows a 'Next unread' button when another workspace is unread, hidden once the PR is merged (renderApp g1o @7,528,638), and Cmd+Alt+L, the palette and the button share openNextUnread in Qre order (nextUnread.ts). Codex sends persist the updated_at bump through db_touch_workspace (setSessionUpdatedAt @1,066,404). Still partial: (1) unread is per workspace (workspaces.unread); Conductor sets it per chat (fe.setUnread on sessions.unread_count), and main's sessions::set_unread / mark_workspace_read have no command or UI caller. (2) Conductor's _p (@2,940,721) also marks unread on a plan review (needs_plan_response @2,945,001), an AskUserQuestion (needs_user_input @2,945,451), a Codex MCP elicitation (@2,946,028) and a Codex MCP permission request (@2,946,583). #567 on 4486363 (main 45006d3): Codex elicitations and permission consents now call chatWantsAttention (codexAsks in attention.ts, codexChat.ts apply), once per new request id, including a second request while one waits; and reportChatStatus calls it when a chat's status enters needs_plan_response or needs_user_input (enteredWait, chatRuntime.ts). But no runtime on main reports needs_plan_response, and only Codex consents report needs_user_input, so plan-review and question waits still never set unread until an agent emits those statuses. Not verified: auto-unread seen in the built app; the Codex consent path is covered by unit tests only (codexChat.test.ts), no e2e.
